title: Fine-tuning cribl-decision (Qwen3.5-4B-Base + LoRA) on the Jev C1 technique question

harness.git_rule: this file is committed before the format probe and before any training; a later change is recorded in amendments with its reason and commit

model.quantization: 4-bit NF4, double quantization, bf16 compute; lm_head, vision tower and MTP head not quantized
model.adapter_check: every tensor of adapter_model.safetensors is in the loaded model bit for bit, else stop

question.framing: Jev C1 (jev_judge.py @ f9b452c): state {sentence, source}, flat choice over the case's first 10 catalogue candidates in rank order, labels 'Name (Txxxx)', what = description cut at 400 characters, none_of_these last
question.rotations: 3 option orders (rotation r moves the first r candidates to the end, none stays last), per-option P floored at 0.005, geometric mean, renormalised; pick = argmax (ties in canonical order); none_of_these = no pick
question.readout: options lettered A..; the prompt ends with 'Answer:'; logits of the tokens ' A' ' B' .. at the last position through the native lm_head, softmax over the offered options

data.train: public tram/expert/derived_procedures train splits (CC-BY-4.0); candidates from scripts/benchmark_mapping.py --split train --modes hybrid with TECHNIQUE_EXEMPLARS_ENABLED=false; exact and near (token Jaccard >= 0.9) duplicates of any dev, test or CTI-HAL text dropped; target = the gold options offered (uniform), else none_of_these
data.dev: public tram+expert dev, 659 cases, the candidate lists of data/audits/jev/framing/s1_dev_c1.json (case_set_hash 86910fc4...)
confirmation: CTI-HAL statements, 968 cases, the candidate lists of s3_cti_hal_statements.json (case_set_hash 1a031870...); local evaluation only
public test tram/expert/derived_procedures, 1391 cases, pipeline top-10 from data/audits/refresh_2026-10-07/public_heldout_current.json
refused_for_training_or_selection: ATT&CK procedure sentences and software 'uses' text (indexed or leaky)

lora_shape.target_modules: language-model linear_attn in_proj_qkv/in_proj_z/in_proj_a/in_proj_b/out_proj and self_attn q/k/v/o_proj (Cribl's shape)

fixed.optimizer: AdamW, lr 1e-4, weight decay 0, cosine schedule with 3% linear warmup, gradient clip 1.0
fixed.batch: 1 example per forward, 16 per optimizer step
fixed.checkpoints: every half epoch, each scored on the full dev split (3 orders)
fixed.example_order: candidates shuffled per example (none_of_these last); epochs reshuffled; seed 7
fixed.loss: cross-entropy of the letter softmax against the target distribution

arms.description: Cribl's adapter zero-shot in the chosen format
control: a fresh LoRA of the same shape on the plain base (init=fresh), same data and schedule

references: pipeline rank-1 (the first candidate) on the same cases
Jev C1 stored picks (dev exact 0.514, CTI-HAL exact 0.460, ECE 0.229 / 0.238)

selection.format: highest exact on the first 200 dev cases with Cribl's adapter (probe.py); ties in the order plain, chat, json
selection.checkpoint: per arm, the highest full-dev exact; ties the earlier checkpoint
selection.finalist: the higher full-dev exact of B1 and B2 (ties B1)

confirmation.runs: B0 and the selected checkpoints of B1 and B2, each once on cti_hal and once on test
confirmation.no_retuning: nothing is chosen, refit or rerun because of a confirmation result

success.headline: the finalist on CTI-HAL: exact minus pipeline rank-1 with a paired 95% CI lower bound above 0, and exact >= Jev C1 (0.460)
secondary: public test: exact minus pipeline rank-1 with a paired 95% CI lower bound above 0
CTI-HAL ECE of P(pick) at most Jev C1's (0.238)
B1 above B2 on dev and CTI-HAL (Cribl's adapter helps)

stop_rules: train gold-in-candidates above 0.95 (the exemplar leak is not closed): stop and inspect
more than 1% of a split's cases end in error
adoption: none: an experiment. Any product use (a local judge in place of Jev, the judge_union arm) is a separate decision with the public held-out gate and the attribution naming gate
reporting: every arm and checkpoint (dev curve), single-order and 3-order numbers, per dataset, no-pick counts, calibration, training time and peak GPU memory; reversals reported as measured
